facts.current: updated 24 July 2026 with predictive ALC map link
facts.guard: overview guidance is not a detailed site survey

facts.survey: strategic maps are not suitable for individual fields; detailed survey may be needed
facts.consultation: Natural England consultation applies in specified cases including certain losses of 20ha or more

facts.soil: soil functions and sustainable management must be considered

facts.guard: predictive mapping does not establish exact field grade
dataset entity is not current parcel-level survey evidence

scope_guards: Strategic or predictive ALC mapping is not treated as an exact field survey.
Grade 3 is not automatically classified as BMV; 3a and 3b require evidence.
A Natural England consultation threshold is not treated as an approval threshold.
BMV presence is not treated as an automatic planning refusal or permission.
Planning Data entities are not treated as current parcel-boundary evidence.
Historic detailed surveys are not assumed current or coextensive with the proposal.
Soil-management commitments are not treated as delivered restoration.
No score or promotion is written without exact parcel, detailed ALC survey, affected area, decision and secured mitigation.
